sources.entry: OBS Studio - A free and open source software for live streaming and screen recording. [![Open-Source Software][OSS Icon]](https://github.com/obsproject/obs-studio)
OBS Studio - Free and open source software for live streaming and screen recording.

summary.one_liner: OBS Studio is free, open source software for capturing, compositing, encoding, recording, and streaming video.
summary.what_it_does: The README describes OBS Studio as software for capturing, compositing, encoding, recording, and streaming video content. It is distributed under the GNU General Public License v2 (or any later version). The README itself is mostly a navigation page: it links to the website, help and documentation, forums, build instructions, developer/API docs, donation pages, and the bug tracker, but does not describe specific features or setup steps in detail. It also covers contribution routes: code follows published style and commit guidelines, translations go through Crowdin rather than pull requests, and support is handled via forums and community chat. A SAST section credits PVS-Studio as a static analyzer used on the project.
use_cases: encoding video for recording or streaming
contributing to an open source video project
notable: Covers capture, compositing, encoding, recording, and streaming in one application
Licensed under GNU GPL v2 or later
caveats: README gives no install or build steps; it points to external build instructions
Language stack (C/C++) is inferred from the project, not stated in the README
